description: Set Claude Code's status line to show context size, the 5-hour and 7-day plan meters with time to reset, the plan cost per message, a warning when the pace reaches the limit before the reset, and the foreign-usage alarm. It also stores each fresh plan reading for claude-usage-guard. Keeps an existing status line unless force. Dry run by default.

force.description: Replace a status line someone else set

threshold.description: Context size that turns the context yellow (red at twice it)

name: install_statusline
